Nice tomeet you

About / My story

I came into web design through e-commerce. For more than six years I worked with online stores on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify and Temu. My first job was at Tradecozone, before I had even started my degree, and I kept working in e-commerce all the way through my studies. Those years taught me how selling online actually works — what a product page has to show, where a checkout loses people, and why a store that is hard to buy from stays quiet.

In 2026 I completed my Bachelor’s in Computer Science, majoring in web and mobile application development. My final year project took first prize in the graduation project program, and I also won first prize in the mock interview program. While studying, I built apps and websites of my own and kept taking on e-commerce work wherever it came.

Now I build the kind of stores I used to work in. I know what a marketplace listing has to do to sell because I have done that job, and I know how to build the site because that is what I trained for. If your products sell on a marketplace but your own website does not, that gap is exactly what I fix.

I work remotely with clients worldwide, and everything runs through my social channels — that’s where I post my builds, and where every project starts. Message me there or by email, tell me what you sell and what isn’t working on your current site, and you’ll see a first version to react to before I build the full site. Then we launch together.

FAQ

Common questions

Working with me

What do you build?

Online stores, landing pages, and redesigns of existing sites. Each one is built to make it easy for customers to buy, book, or contact you.

Who do you work with?

Small businesses, creators, and brands worldwide. If you sell something or need people to get in touch, I can help.

How do we start?

Send me a DM on TikTok (@henryknowsweb) or an email with what you sell, who your customers are, and what isn’t working on your current site. I’ll reply with questions and next steps.

Cost and timing

How does pricing work?

Every project is quoted as a fixed price after we talk through your brief, and before any work starts. No surprise costs.

How much does a website cost?

It depends on the pages, features, and content. Starting prices: a landing page from $350 (one page, up to 6 sections, mobile layout, 2 revision rounds, basic SEO setup); an online store from $1,000 (up to 30 products, checkout and payments set up, up to 5 pages, 2 revision rounds); a redesign from $700 (up to 5 pages, new design, mobile layout, 2 revision rounds). After the brief I’ll send a fixed quote before any work starts.

How long does it take?

A landing page usually takes 5–7 days, a store 3–5 weeks, and a redesign 2–4 weeks, counted from the day I receive your text, photos, and content. The timeline mostly depends on how quickly I get your content and feedback.

Do you take a deposit?

Yes — 30% upfront, and the rest before the final files are handed over and the site launches. I’ll put it in writing before starting.

What payment methods do you accept?

Payoneer, bank transfer, or crypto. All quotes are in USD.

What’s included

What’s your process?

Brief, Design, Build, Launch. You tell me what you need, you see a first version, I build the full site, and we go live together.

Can you build an online store?

Yes. I build stores on Shopify and WooCommerce, and on Hostinger, with checkout and payments set up so you can start taking orders.

Do you handle domain and hosting?

Either way works: I can set it up for you, or guide you through it. The domain and hosting accounts stay in your name, so you always own them.

Do I need to provide the text and images?

It helps if you do. If you don’t have them, tell me what you can share and we’ll work out the gaps.

Will my site work on phones?

Yes. Every site is designed for phone, tablet, and desktop.

Will people be able to find my site on Google?

I set up the basics: page titles, descriptions, headings, fast loading, and a sitemap. Ranking takes time and depends on competition and your content, and I can’t promise a position.

After launch

Who owns the website?

You do. Once the final payment is made, the site and its files are yours.

What if I need changes after launch?

Two rounds of revisions are included while we build. After launch, small fixes are free for 30 days. Bigger changes are quoted separately.

Do you offer ongoing support?

Not as a monthly plan right now. After the 30-day fix window, I quote changes as you need them — just DM or email me.

Trust

Can I see your work?

My own showcase builds are being added now, and I only show work I made. I’d rather wait than show someone else’s work as mine. Feel free to DM me for a sample or a call.

Do you offer a free mockup or consultation?

A free 15-minute consultation, yes — DM me and we’ll talk through your project. A free mockup, no.

What if I’m not happy?

Before you pay a deposit, we agree on the brief, price, and deliverables in writing. You get two rounds of revisions, and if the first design isn’t right, I’ll rework it. If you cancel before I start, you get your deposit back. Once I’ve started, the deposit covers the work done so far. If I can’t deliver what we agreed after your revisions, I’ll refund the unused part of what you’ve paid. After launch, I fix any bugs I caused for 30 days.
